test_description: Per-IC protocol decode for a 74LS138 (3-to-8 decoder) during a +7 dBm → -5 dBm level sweep. All 8 /Y outputs probed. The protocol_decode analyser reports which /Y fired and when, so a stuck or missing /Y output is visible. Use this for AD4 IC1 (the prime suspect), AA2/1 IC13, AA2/1 IC17, or any AC13 '138.

ch1.notes: fewer than 2 edges — no intervals to analyse

ch3.notes: 9.8% of intervals are sub-100ns — mild aliasing. Worth a scope check on this signal.

events.operator_input: 7dbm -> -5dbm and back up again IC1 on AC3/13 board
